items.headline: Anthropic's IPO Filing Reveals Nearly $900 Billion in Compute Commitments
items.summary: Anthropic's amended S-1 filing discloses total infrastructure purchase commitments of about $895.4 billion, with roughly $447.5 billion due by the end of 2030, underscoring the staggering capital intensity behind keeping Claude running at scale.

items.headline: Anthropic Tells IPO Investors Claude Is Helping Design Its Own Chips
items.summary: The Information reports that Anthropic's new 15-person chip design team is already using Claude on custom silicon projects, while the company says it will keep sourcing compute from Nvidia, AMD, AWS, and Google rather than depending on a single hardware partner.

items.headline: Anthropic Clarifies Policy on Banning Persistently Abusive Claude Users
items.summary: Anthropic detailed an enforcement policy under which users who are persistently harmful or abusive toward Claude in conversation can, in extreme cases, face a permanent ban, though the company says Claude ending the conversation remains its main response.

items.headline: Anthropic Confirms Claude Code Now Refuses to Recreate Existing Video Games
items.summary: Anthropic confirmed it added instructions to Claude Code on its Opus 5.5 model steering it away from rebuilding specific existing games to avoid IP infringement, a change some legitimate developers say is causing false refusals on original projects.

items.headline: OpenAI Publishes Briefs Defending Fair Use of Copyrighted Works in AI Training
items.summary: OpenAI highlighted excerpts from roughly 20 amicus filings urging a New York court to find that training large language models on copyrighted material is fair use, part of its defense in the ongoing lawsuit brought by The New York Times.

items.headline: OpenAI Scales Back Fundraising Target to $20 Billion
items.summary: OpenAI is reportedly seeking up to $20 billion in its latest funding round, down from an earlier $30 billion goal, with the round said to value the company at around $1.25 trillion on a post-money basis.

items.headline: OpenAI to Merge ChatGPT and Codex Usage Limits Starting in December
items.summary: OpenAI confirmed that its Plus, Pro, and Business ChatGPT plans will move to a single shared, token-based usage allowance covering both ChatGPT and Codex beginning in December, consolidating what had been separate quotas.
items.source: Pasquale Pillitteri (reporting OpenAI help center update)

items.headline: Unitree Founder Says GPT-6 Could Trigger a Robotics 'ChatGPT Moment' Within Two Years
items.summary: Wang Xingxing, founder of humanoid robot maker Unitree, said OpenAI's GPT-6 model has raised his expectations that embodied AI could reach a breakthrough moment within one to two years, after testing the model on robotics tasks including painting and playing Go.

items.headline: Meta Details Prometheus Supercluster Scaling Toward 1 Million GPUs
items.summary: Meta's engineering team published a technical account of its Prometheus data center in Ohio, describing progress toward a roughly 1-million-GPU supercluster that trained the company's Muse AI models and cut daily compute-cluster failures by 99%.
